# Prevention-system completion research

## Current state
The complete property does not hold system-wide. The registry still separates classification, selection, activation, run start, guarding, verification, and close; the research runner is one representative complete owner rather than a generic prevention-system owner. Typed exact schemas exist in selected controllers, but checked execution still accepts arbitrary argv, the guard compares shell strings, and work-memory accepts JSON-file and argv-JSON inputs. Pre-action enforcement is opt-in through skill compliance: direct shell, edit, MCP/tool, browser, subagent, and remote-workflow action boundaries can bypass applicability selection. Corrections are strongly evidence-bound but only become selectable when callers supply fingerprint context; they are not universally mandatory. Observer-to-discovery evidence and promotion controllers exist, but promotion is explicitly invoked and a later link does not dispatch the implementation. Research admission reserves core, one concurrent lens window, and adjudicator time, omitting retries, materialization, package verification, terminal emission, and controller overhead. Durable resume exists in selected slices but not through one common journal across every sequence. Current metrics omit the system-wide registered-use denominator, raw rate, prevented failures, mechanical-failure time, promoted reuse, and real-run overhead proof.

## Complete future system
Every registered operational sequence needs one deterministic typed invocation backed by a closed operation registry. An unavoidable dispatcher interceptor must derive the intended typed operation, select one compatible registered implementation or fail closed, and cover every action class. Same-path-verified correction evidence must prohibit the predecessor and make the active successor mandatory. One causal lineage must join intent through registered verification and reuse while preserving qualification and promotion authorities. Admission must reserve core, three gates, adjudication, retries, materialization, verification, terminal emission, and overhead before launch. A shared transition/effect journal must give every sequence exact-once recovery, multi-run preservation, and branch-safe ownership. Canonical events and denominators must measure registered use, raw dispatch, mechanical failures, recurrence, promoted reuse, prevention, and total overhead.

## Acceptance
The final implementation must prove zero raw governed dispatch, zero execution of a prohibited repeated fingerprint, zero long-stage launch below full-unit budget, mandatory corrected-path selection on a fresh compatible task, at least 95 percent registered use over an explicit recurring-action denominator, and at most 10 percent mechanical overhead over representative real governed runs. Synthetic timing tests are not sufficient for the last condition.

closed operation registry with exact schemas and pre-mutation rejection

no predecessor execution claim; successor or hold
reserve before any launch and record rejection
